claims.safe: Maize was domesticated from teosinte in southwestern Mexico roughly 9,000 years ago.
Domestication changed branching, ear size/structure and seed dispersal.
Guilá Naquitz remains document ancient domestication traits.
Some genetic regions have large effects, but maize domestication involved many changes.
Later maize history includes dispersal and gene flow; avoid collapsing total history into one clean event.
